query: update transforms.run as r set state = 'failed', error = 'reporting lost', finished_at = now() where r.state = 'running' and r.started_at <= $1 and not exists ( select 1 from queue.jobs j where j.state in ('available', 'running') and (j.payload->>'run_id')::uuid = r.run_id ) returning r.run_id
